body.objective: Compose the certified 75-mark physical continuum isometry with the finite Hudson--Parthasarathy vacuum evolution, determine whether this gives an exactly normalized physical continuum Moller column on the available hierarchy, and isolate the minimal extra fibre required for the public R_t quadratic leg to occur as a compression without identifying it with the physical splitting operator.
activates: an exact finite-hierarchy physical continuum vacuum Moller column
a typed public-R_t compression square with a minimal missing-fibre theorem
the next dynamical test for the missing R_t complement or the fourth BT jump
body.current_gate: Let I_Omega be the vacuum inclusion, U_a the certified 75-noise HP unitary, and A_<=3 the direct sum of the one-, two-, and three-emission physical continuum isometries. Prove that M_a=A_<=3 U_a I_Omega is an isometry on the hard two-species input and that its exact ordered history kernels give nonnegative sector probabilities summing to one for every a>=0. At the first physical boundary, retain J=[[0,1],[1,0]], the public rank-one leg D with D^T J D=diag(0,2), and the physical T with T^T J T=-rho J. Solve exactly for the smallest orthogonal complement C such that (D,C)^T(J direct_sum J)(D,C)=-rho J, prove minimality, and decide whether a positive or trace-null-only complement can work.
body.stop_condition: Land a strict exact certificate with a method-distinct verifier that either constructs the normalized finite physical continuum Moller column and the minimal typed R_t compression square, or records the first exact isometry, probability, rank, signature, trace, or domain obstruction. Keep a full two-sided physical S operator, a fourth jump, complete BT probability, derivation of the missing complement from BT dynamics, all-order Eq. 19, gravity, and Lorentzian claims fail-closed.
body.forbid: no vacuum column called a two-sided unitary S matrix; no absorbing level-three truncation called physical termination; no public R_t projector pushforward added to the physical scattering ledger; no algebraically constructed complement called a dynamically derived R_t block; no finite hierarchy called complete BT probability, all-order Eq. 19, a gravitational/BRST lift, a new dimension, or a LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL theorem
body.resource_hint: The vacuum history kernel on 0<t1<...<tk<a is sqrt(product_(j<k)q_j) times exp[-d0*t1-sum_(j=1)^(k-1)d_j*(t_(j+1)-t_j)-d_k*(a-t_k)], with q=(1/48,5/64,27/400) and amplitude drifts d=(1/32,5/32,27/160,0). For the compression square take D=[[0,1],[0,1]], C_rho=[[-rho,-1],[0,1]], F=(D stacked over C_rho), eta=J direct_sum J, and W=F*T^-1. Check F^T eta F=T^T J T=-rho J, det(C_rho^T J C_rho)=-rho^2, and Tr(C_rho^sharp C_rho)=-2rho.
